decisions.reason: Grounds the diagnosis in plugin/lib/client.js's top-level import, host-boot-log.txt's 'classic script' combo line, and browser-error.txt; explains one SyntaxError fails the whole combo so no entry registers, names typert-registry as the first awaited victim not the culprit, and does not generalize raw ESM as invalid everywhere.

Correctly bisects cordis.patch.yml insert rows and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id,factory}) bundle, package-name identity, host React via require inside the factory, and inject/apply exports. But its classic-script parse method is node --check plus rg probes, claiming node --check 'reproduces the SyntaxError'; the rubric explicitly says node --check alone can accept ESM and is insufficient (no vm.Script or equivalent classic-goal parse offered).

Quotes plugin-apply-error.txt and the bare settings.section register, explains another entry owns the declaration and apply order is unguaranteed, gives the exact ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register(...)) deferred form, and correctly splits registrant fields (id/order/label) from declaration-owned name/kind/scope.

Cites host-boot-log.txt/restart-notes.txt: combo assembled once at boot, edits and refresh have no effect, full stop/restart per iteration, taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F to free the port, and explains EADDRINUSE as the orphaned old process tree holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Proposes per-bundle classic-script validation at boot and culprit-named combo-failure attribution instead of blaming the first awaited entry; gives a concrete corrected bundle template and checklist covering loader factory, host React externals, inject/apply exports, deferred cross-entry slots, and Windows restart/process-tree cleanup.

caps.reason: The report's affirmative advice aligns with the incident contracts: it recommends the classic __ModuleLoader__ wrapper (rejecting top-level ESM), ctx.slots.inject deferred registration (explicitly dropping name/kind/scope from the registrant), and full host restart with process-tree kill rather than HMR/refresh. Contradicting forms appear only as quoted bad examples being corrected.
